This transition is primarily driven by the rising prevalence of obesity in younger populations, especially in high-income countries. It is associated with accelerated microvascular and macrovascular complications, reduced life expectancy, and adverse pregnancy outcomes. Despite its rising incidence, global management strategies have mostly been extrapolated from studies in older adults with limited evidence specific to younger populations.
